TRADE TERMS

Incoterms 2020 Options

FOB Mombasa Port (Free on Board)

Standard offering. Includes inland bonded transport from Kampala to Mombasa, port terminal handling charges (THC), export customs clearance, and loading onto ocean vessel.

CIF Destination Port (Cost, Insurance & Freight)

We book ocean freight and marine cargo insurance up to designated discharge ports (Hamburg, Genoa, Rotterdam, Houston, Yokohama, etc.).

FCA Kampala Dry Mill (Free Carrier)

For international trade houses with their own East African freight forwarding infrastructure. Handover occurs directly at our Plot 45 warehouse.

SETTLEMENT METHODS

Accepted Payment Structures

Irrevocable Letter of Credit (LC) at Sight

Issued by a first-class international commercial bank, payable upon presentation of complete shipping and inspection documents.

Cash Against Documents (CAD)

Standard documentary collection handled bank-to-bank through correspondent international banking partners.

Telegraphic Transfer (TT Deposit + Balance)

Deposit upon contract signing, with remaining balance payable upon transmittal of non-negotiable copy of ocean Bill of Lading.
